prompt: Which North Atlantic tropical storm, whose peak intensity remained at tropical storm level, caused the highest number of deaths last year?
answer: **Tropical Storm Chantal** (July 4–7, 2025) caused the most deaths among 2025 North Atlantic systems that never exceeded tropical-storm strength, with **six direct fatalities**. Most resulted from flooding in North Carolina.
